meta.title: Spring Boneアニメーション処理の最適化: get_bone_name関数のキャッシュ戦略改善
meta.body_summary: Optimize get_bone_name caching by replacing full cache clear with targeted eviction and adding a secondary armature-level cache, claiming 3% function improvement and 1.4% overall Spring Bone speedup based on profiling.

perf_labels.notes: Devin provided profiling evidence for a 3% cache improvement; maintainer closed without review after Devin was archived.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 29 changed lines, this is a very small, focused edit. It fits a micro-optimization performance PR; however, it was closed without review, possibly due to bot inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: In src/io_scene_vrm/editor/property_group.py, get_bone_name was modified to evict only stale cache entries instead of clearing the entire cache, added a secondary per-armature cache, and reduced redundant get_bone_extension calls.
change_trajectory: Single commit: replaced cache-clearing with targeted eviction, added armature-level UUID-to-name mapping, and minimized bone extension lookups.
